description: Colleen O'Donnell served nearly a decade as a Common Pleas Court Judge in Franklin County and later as a Federal Immigration Judge in Texas, handling asylum cases. With experience at both the state and federal levels, she’s known for her integrity, work ethic, and dedication to the Constitution and the rule of law.
